responsibility: Declares the compiler-facing coverage interface used by instrumentation and profile readers. It exposes file-level setup/teardown, per-function coverage begin/end hooks, checksum/profile-id computation, counter allocation and tree references for generated instrumentation, count retrieval from gcda input, and helpers such as get_gcov_type and node-map status. This header is the main API by which profile.cc, tree profiling code, and related passes interact with compiler-managed gcov coverage data.
same_name_distinction: This header is the API that other compiler profiling code includes to request coverage setup, per-function hooks, counter allocation, checksum computation, and count lookup. Unlike gcc/coverage.cc, it does not manage gcda/gcno files or build the emitted coverage objects itself.
